summary: Review randomized experiments for allocation integrity, estimand alignment, attrition, interference and analysis choices before accepting causal language.

must_inspect.why: Causal interpretation depends on how assignment occurred and whether the analysis preserves that assignment for the stated estimand.
false_positive_guards: Do not equate missing allocation detail with failed randomization; mark unreported procedures as reporting gaps.

must_inspect.why: Differential attrition can break the comparability created by random assignment.
false_positive_guards: Low attrition is not automatically ignorable; inspect whether missingness differs by arm and relates to outcome risk.

must_inspect.why: Spillover or treatment contamination can change the estimand even when allocation itself is valid.
false_positive_guards: Do not invent interference when treatment cannot plausibly propagate across units.
Do not upgrade a reporting omission into a design failure without evidence.
handoff_triggers: Current methodological standards -> evidence-researcher when external verification is requested
